Syllabus and Roadmap

Curriculum structure plus milestone waves for delivery.

Syllabus

Syllabus

Phase 00 - Colab and GPU Setup

Goal: make every learner productive in Google Colab with GPU runtime checks and baseline benchmarking habits.

Phase 01 - GPU Fundamentals

Goal: build intuition for CPU vs GPU, memory hierarchy, throughput/latency, and matrix multiplication performance.

Phase 02 - GPU Programming Without Fear

Goal: teach practical acceleration patterns (vectorization, device placement, avoiding transfer overhead).

Phase 03 - GPUs for Data Science

Goal: improve model training speed and memory efficiency with practical PyTorch techniques.

Phase 04 - GPUs for Data Engineering

Goal: apply GPU acceleration to ETL and analytics workflows.

Phase 05 - GPUs for DevOps and MLOps

Goal: understand GPU scheduling, observability, and serving tradeoffs in production-like scenarios.

Phase 06 - Optimization and Cost Engineering

Goal: optimize for both speed and cost with precision, batching, and quantization techniques.

Phase 07 - Capstone Projects by Role

Goal: deliver role-specific capstones for DevOps, Data Science, and Data Engineering tracks.

Wave Milestones

Roadmap

Phase Rollout Strategy

Wave 1 (MVP Foundations)

  • Complete 00-colab-and-gpu-setup.
  • Complete 01-gpu-fundamentals.
  • Launch public GitHub Pages site with copy-enabled code blocks.

Wave 2 (Acceleration Core)

  • Ship 02-gpu-programming-without-fear.
  • Ship 03-gpus-for-data-science.
  • Add mixed precision and batch tuning benchmark labs.

Wave 3 (Infrastructure and Data)

  • Ship 04-gpus-for-data-engineering.
  • Ship 05-gpus-for-devops-mlops.
  • Add production simulation artifacts (runbooks, profiling templates).

Wave 4 (Optimization and Capstone)

  • Ship 06-optimization-and-cost-engineering.
  • Ship 07-capstone-projects-by-role.
  • Publish role-specific capstone rubrics and completion criteria.

Quality Standards

  • Each Build/Project lesson has a runnable Colab notebook.
  • Each lesson has docs/en.md and at least one output artifact.
  • Catalog generation and lesson validation pass in CI.

Success Metrics

  • Learners can run all MVP labs in Colab without local setup.
  • Lesson pages provide copy buttons for every code block.
  • GitHub Pages deployment is automated and stable.
Colab-first curriculum. Open source on GitHub.
